result.summary: The street features a wide multi-lane roadway with a central median refuge and sidewalks on both sides. Although a textured pavement area indicates a crossing, the lack of high-visibility markings and visible pedestrian signals increases risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crossing area uses textured pavement but lacks high-visibility paint, which may fail to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic, increasing their exposure time to vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Add continental or ladder-style painted markings to the textured crossing area to improve visibility for motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers at the intersection to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features sidewalks and street lighting but lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. A pedestrian is shown crossing an unmarked area, highlighting the exposure risk due to the absence of designated crossing zones.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at an intersection where pedestrians are likely to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the center of the image.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signals to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sight lines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads. The environment features a mix of modern residential/commercial development and vacant land, with wide travel lanes that may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian crossing points unclear to drivers.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe for people to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and curb ramps adjacent to a commercial land use. However, the wide roadway and lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings in the immediate foreground increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic during a crossing maneuver.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main thoroughfare in the center of the image

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are not high-visibility, which may reduce driver awareness of the crossing zone.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
